<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Disturb the Water to Catch a Fish</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
In the chaos following the defeat of mighty Cao Cao at the Battle of
Red Cliffs (208 A.D.), Liu Bei was able to establish the Kingdom of
Shu (221 A.D.), taking the strategic Yangzi city of Jinzhou. He was
then able to take the city of Yizhou while its internal struggles
distracted the dominant forces there [9].</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Disturb
the Water to Catch a Fish</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
is associated with the seventeenth hexagram, <i>Lake
over Thunder</i>. The
Lake, being in the upper position, is understood to come first, and
Thunder, being in the lower, follows. Thunder, representing motion,
is initiated, thereby provoking a response, changing the orientation
of the situation [1],
[28].</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span>


	
	
	
	

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">

LIST 20:</span></span></span></b></p>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section31" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	<span style="font-size: large;">to get stuck: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">卡住</span></span>:
	kǎ zhù   
	</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to break: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">弄坏</span></span>:
	nòng huài   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	any: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">任何</span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">随便</span></span>:
	rènhé/suíbiàn   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large; text-decoration: none;">to
	put together: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">拼</span></span></span>:
	pīn</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;"><span><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
	</span></span></span></span>
	</p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to feel: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">感觉</span></span>:
	gǎnjué</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to try: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">试</span></span>:
	shì   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-source-rmn50"></a></span>

	try: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">试一下</span></span></span>:
	shì yīxià   </span>
	</p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	it’s...turn (e.g. it’s his turn): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">轮到</span></span>...:

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">

	shítáng   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">to touch/to find out:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;" lang="zh-CN">摸:

	  </span></span>

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">

<div dir="ltr" id="Section72" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	1) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那是什么声音？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我不知道，听起来好像骆驼。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">2)
	I. <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">能不能从这里走到餐厅？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;&nbsp; II. <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">哪一个餐厅？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;&nbsp; III. <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">随便哪个都好。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">3)<span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">飞机场现在非常混乱。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">4)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你为什么问我这个问题？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我就是有点好奇。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">5)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我每次把骨头给那只狗，它都要挖一个洞</span></span>
    </span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;埋起来。</span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">6)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你如果不习惯这么干的天气，鼻子有可能</span></span>
    </span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;会流血。</span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">7)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">别弄坏了，<span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;">
	</span>让我试一下。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.:
	Don’t break it, let me try.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">8)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">轮到他的时候，<span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;">
	</span>电脑卡住了。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.:
	When it was his turn, the computer froze.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">9)<span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">爷爷摸了摸小男孩的头。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">10)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们应该讨论下，怎么把这个拼起来。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">11)
	</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">你有没有感觉到有一点冷？</span></span></p>
